title: Data Efficient Evaluation of Large Language Models and Text-to-Image Models via Adaptive Sampling
findings: The paper's findings related to religion were methodological rather than performance-based. It found that for the MMLU subject 'world_religions', the optimal adaptive sampling method to preserve ranking and score distribution was 'quality_CPD' (a quality-based sampling method).
